integrity: Self-contained mathematical proof accompanied by independent finite rational-state and enumeration checks; no independent scientific audit or external certification.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to two homogeneous competing runs of equal length in iid Bernoulli trials.
Strong stochastic ordering, not likelihood-ratio ordering, is shown after common-noise convolution.
Sharp Wasserstein upper constant is approached at a boundary but not attained for any positive interior probability.
A plausible older conditional-run chapter was not available for full-text priority comparison.
title: Winner-conditioned transport for competing Bernoulli runs
